glyph_origin: Ideogrammic compound (會意) and phono-semantic compound (形聲): phonetic 卓 (“high”) + semantic 木 (“tree; wood”) – table. The bottom 十 of 卓 has merged with or been replaced by 木. An obsolete variant that distinguishes the two components is 棹.
senses: [zhuō] classifier for tablefuls of dishes or people
